subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): surface accountId on agent hook context

question: Should `accountId` become the canonical public plugin agent-hook context field, with internal `agentAccountId` mapped before the exported helper boundary?
rationale: The field name and semantics become a long-lived third-party SDK contract, while the current branch also exposes an explicitly temporary internal alias that repository policy says should not become permanent compatibility surface without intent.

options.title: Approve canonical accountId
options.body: Accept `ctx.accountId` and require the branch to remove the exported `agentAccountId` alias by mapping internal callers at the boundary.

options.title: Support both names
options.body: Intentionally publish both helper inputs and document precedence, compatibility purpose, and a concrete deprecation or retention plan.

options.title: Pause the SDK addition
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a different account-identity contract or decide plugins should obtain this fact through another seam.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical accountId
recommendation.body: Accept `ctx.accountId` and require the branch to remove the exported `agentAccountId` alias by mapping internal callers at the boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is recent ownership of the central hook-context types, builder, and harness propagation surfaces.
